caption: The drawing depicts a simple wooden bench with a rectangular, solid top and four cylindrical legs. The bench is depicted in a three-quarters perspective, showing the top surface, one long side, and the front short side, as well as all four legs. The wood appears light brown, with visible grain details and two round wooden dowels or plugs on the top surface of the bench. The legs of the bench are slightly tapered and angled outward. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist’s name, "LeRoy Griffith," is written in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Dough Trough Bench
